actions.description: Submit an application on behalf of a candidate. This endpoint can only be used to submit applications to published or unlisted postings.
actions.name: apply-posting

actions.description: Action to create a note and add it to an opportunity.
actions.name: create-note

opportunityId.description: Opportunity ID to attach the note to. Example: "6408dc54-7015-4e5b-8d60-23afff2b1efc"

perform_as.description: Lever user ID to attribute the note to.

note_id.description: Existing note ID to update instead of creating a new note.

notifyFollowers.description: Whether to notify followers of the note.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when the note was created.

actions.description: Create an opportunity and optionally candidates associated with the opportunity
actions.name: create-opportunity

perform_as.description: Lever user ID to attribute this change to. Example: "c4bc6266-375b-4d45-9b3b-ad527ba5f3ef"

actions.description: Get single post for your account in Lever
actions.name: get-posting

actions.description:
Get all posts for your account. Note that this does
not paginate the response so it is possible that not all postings 
are returned.
actions.name: get-postings

actions.description:
Action to get lists all pipeline stages. Note that this does 
not paginate the response so it is possible that not all stages 
are returned.
actions.name: get-stages

actions.description: Update the archived state of an opportunity
actions.name: update-opportunity-archived

cleanInterviews.description: Whether to remove pending interviews when archiving.

requisitionId.description: Requisition ID to hire the candidate against.

perform_as.description: Lever user ID to perform this action on behalf of.

actions.description: Update the links in an opportunity
actions.name: update-opportunity-links

delete.description: When true, removes the given links instead of adding them.

actions.description: Update the sources in an opportunity
actions.name: update-opportunity-sources

sources.description: Array of source names to add or remove. Example: ["Facebook"]

delete.description: When true, removes the given sources instead of adding them.

perform_as.description: Lever user ID to perform this action as. Required for most mutating endpoints.

actions.description: Update the stage in an opportunity
actions.name: update-opportunity-stage

perform_as.description: Lever user ID to perform this action as. Required for most mutating endpoints.

actions.description: Update the tags in an opportunity
actions.name: update-opportunity-tags

opportunityId.description: The ID of the opportunity to update. Example: "6408dc54-7015-4e5b-8d60-23afff2b1efc"

tags.description: Array of tag names to add or remove from the opportunity. Example: ["Engineering", "Referral"]

delete.description: When true, removes the given tags instead of adding them.

perform_as.description: The ID of the user to attribute this change to. Example: "be129d9b-50da-4485-9377-0d83e981f30b"

actions.description: Lists all the users in your Lever account. Only active users are included by default.
actions.name: users

syncs.description: Fetches a list of all applications for a candidate in Lever
syncs.name: opportunities-applications

syncs.description: Fetches a list of all feedback forms for a candidate for every single opportunity
syncs.name: opportunities-feedbacks

syncs.description: Fetches a list of all interviews for every single opportunity
syncs.name: opportunities-interviews

syncs.description: Fetches a list of all notes for every single opportunity
syncs.name: opportunities-notes

syncs.description: Fetches a list of all offers for every single opportunity
syncs.name: opportunities-offers

syncs.description: Fetches all archive reasons configured on the account.
syncs.name: archive-reasons

syncs.description: Fetches all feedback/interview scorecard templates on the account.
syncs.name: feedback-templates

syncs.description: Fetches a list of all interview scheduling panels for every single opportunity
syncs.name: opportunities-panels

syncs.description: Fetches a list of all referrals for every single opportunity
syncs.name: opportunities-referrals

syncs.description: Fetches a list of all postings in Lever
syncs.name: postings

syncs.description: Fetches a list of all questions included in a posting's application form in Lever
syncs.name: postings-questions

syncs.description: Fetches all requisitions on the account.
syncs.name: requisitions

syncs.description: Fetches all candidate sources configured on the account.
syncs.name: sources

syncs.description: Fetches a list of all pipeline stages in Lever
syncs.name: stages

syncs.description: Fetches all candidate/opportunity tags configured on the account.
syncs.name: tags

syncs.description: Fetches all webhook subscriptions configured on the account.
syncs.name: webhooks
